name: יְחִיָּה
summary: A Levite gatekeeper for the ark when David brought it up to Jerusalem, named beside Obed-edom (1Ch 15:24); TIPNR takes him to be the Jeiel (יְעִיאֵל) named among the gatekeepers in 1Ch 15:18. The name is formed as יְחִיאֵל, with the divine name יָהּ for אֵל: “may Yah live”.

evidence.note: “Obed-edom וִיחִיָּה were gatekeepers for the ark.”
יְחִי הַמֶּלֶךְ: the jussive the name is built on.

note: Takes h.cd.am (one token). The identification with Jeiel is TIPNR's, which lists יְחִיָּה as a form of Jeiel@1Ch.15.18; if a name entry for Jeiel (יְעִיאֵל, another root) is written, both will name that person, each by its own key.
